variants.headline: Looking back: company lays off many workers
variants.sub: Many workers have been laid off by {company}.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The company {company} had laid off many workers.

The gazette records the large layoff without assigning a count or a reason not supplied in the report. A reduction in employment and the failure of a company are distinct events. The account should not imply that the business has closed, or that a particular assistance arrangement has been established.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We support {target} against a blanket adverse verdict. The layoff is serious, but the report does not establish every claim about its causes or prove that a particular imagined alternative was available.
